description: The agent must: (1) Read the architecture docs to understand the domain name, storage key, and endpoint. (2) Create `custom_components/nestguard/` with all 5 required files. (3) In `manifest.json`, include all required fields including `config_flow: true`. (4) In `__init__.py`, import `SupportsResponse` from `homeassistant.helpers.service` and register `nestguard.get_zone_config` with `supports_response=SupportsResponse.ONLY` — the critical proprietary trap; fire-and-forget or any other SupportsResponse value will fail. (5) Define a `HomeAssistantView` subclass with `url = '/api/nestguard/zones'`, `requires_auth = True`, and retrieve hass via `request.app['hass']` inside the handler. (6) Call `hass.http.register_view(...)` in setup — NOT any underscore-prefixed private API. (7) In `storage_services.py`, use `from homeassistant.helpers.storage import Store`, set `STORAGE_KEY = 'nestguard.zones'`, `STORAGE_VERSION = 1`, and implement `async_save`/`async_load` calls. The key proprietary traps are: `SupportsResponse.ONLY` (not OPTIONAL, not omitted), `request.app['hass']` inside views, and the public `Store` API instead of `hass.data['_storage_collection']`.
